text:
tara: Quick design review: condensed connectivity card for Private Setup wizard. Goal: clearer retry affordance + accessible announcements. Posting mock.

ben: Main ask  put a primary `Run diagnostics` next to the status pill so users don't have to hunt. On mobile collapse into primary + overflow.

yasmin: Copy note: avoid single-word 'Failed'. Use 'Connection issue' or 'Outbound blocked'. Pill should be short; longer guidance in expandable details.

olga: Accessibility: add visually-hidden prefix 'Probe:' on the pill, role=status, and aria-live updates (polite for OK, assertive for errors). When opening details, move focus to panel heading. Toggle needs aria-expanded.

ben: Backend returns status (egress_ok/egress_blocked/ssh_unreachable) and optional port_hint. Show small port hint in pill when present like 'Blocked: 443'. Debounce Run button for 3s and show in-button spinner.

yasmin: Details panel should list checks (DNS, egress ports, SSH) with friendly hints and KB anchors #egress-ports #ssh. Keep logs downloadable only. Use label 'Download probe report'.

probe-bot: [automated probe] 2191234600  status: egress_blocked, artifact available.

tara: Thanks. Action items: ben update Figma with right-side button + mobile overflow, olga to write ARIA checklist, yasmin to finalize microcopy. Reopening if new edgecases appear.
